Two boys, the sons of Ariel, an indigeneous Qom (Toba) father, sitting on a mound of earth beside their home.

Ariel, left his community at the age of 13 to live in the small city of Bermejito due to a lack of resources. He lived there until the age of 18 when he moved to Santa Fe where he made a living from collecting cardboard. In 2010, he returned to Bermejito with his wife and children where they currently live from government handouts and small jobs. Ariel complains about the lack of job opportunities and real help from the Government or local authorities.
